title: TUR autopilot check
description: What 'works' means for one application when tur-runtime's compatibility autopilot runs it (docs/architecture/compat-autopilot.md): a window of its own, an exit status, texts in its output. A run also fails when Wine reports that the process was ended (a crash, a DLL that failed to initialise, imports that could not be resolved). Without a check file the autopilot uses the default: a window within 60 seconds, then 3 seconds up or an exit with status 0.

window.description: Whether a window of the program must appear.

window_class.description: The X11 class of the window; by default the program's file name in lower case, which is what Wine sets.

exit.description: zero: the program exits by itself with status 0. zero-or-running: it exits with 0 or is still running when it is stopped. any: any exit, or none.

settle_seconds.description: How long the program must stay up after its window appeared. Less than the timeout.

arguments.description: Arguments the program is started with.
